# ClearedToCode Vantage

Camera add-on for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024: tower, runway, fly-by, chase
and orbit cameras, the aircraft's own cameras, level horizon, saved views, and
hotkeys that accept any key or joystick, throttle and HOTAS button. The zip
contains the Setup and the Stream Deck plugin.

Vantage is also included in the [Airline Hub Suite](../airline-hub/).
